Story.problemLead: For a family managing CMPA, supermarket label review can take time and focus.
Story.problemBody: Reading every label, looking for terms like caseinates or whey, and checking 'may contain' wording can be stressful. SafeBite helps make that review faster, but the physical label always stays the source of truth.
Story.solutionLead: SafeBite helps highlight possible milk-related terms in seconds.
Story.solutionBody: The main scan works directly on your phone. No internet is needed to read the label, and product photos are not uploaded for analysis.
Story.step1Desc: Point your camera at the ingredient list.
Story.step2Desc: SafeBite highlights possible milk-related terms and trace warnings.
Story.step3Desc: Read the full physical label and confirm before making decisions.

InfoSection.aplvDescription: CMPA is an immune reaction to proteins found in cow’s milk, such as casein and whey. It is different from lactose intolerance.
InfoSection.ingredientsBody:
• Cow's milk (in all forms)
• Casein and Caseinates
• Whey
• Lactose (may contain traces)
• Cream, Butter, Cheese, Yogurt
• Annatto extract (sometimes contains milk)
InfoSection.shoppingBody:
• ALWAYS read the label, even if you already know the product.
• Look for the phrase 'Contains: Milk' at the bottom of the list.
• Beware of cross-contamination ('May contain...', 'Processed on equipment...').
• Prefer foods with certified 'Vegan' or 'Dairy-Free' seals.
InfoSection.resourcesBody:
• Substitutes: Almond, soy, rice, oat milk.
• Calcium: Broccoli, spinach, almonds, fortified tofu.
• For cooking: Use coconut oil or vegetable margarine instead of butter.
InfoSection.severeSymptoms: For severe symptoms such as difficulty breathing, swelling of the tongue or throat, or faintness, follow your medical emergency plan and contact emergency services immediately.
InfoSection.epinephrineNotice: If epinephrine has been prescribed, follow your doctor’s instructions and call emergency services immediately.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At SafeBite, we value your privacy and the security of your information. This policy describes how we handle your data in our mobile application.
Privacy.designBody: The label image-to-text and ingredient review flow runs on your device. Product photos are not uploaded for OCR or scan-history sync. If you create an account, account details and saved scan results can be sent to SafeBite's services to provide sign-in and history sync.
Privacy.collectionBody:
We process data needed to provide the features you use.
• Account data: Email, profile details, and account identifiers when you create an account.
• Scan history: Signed-in scan results can sync to your account. Guest scan history remains on the device and is temporary. Product photos are not included in scan-history sync.
• App activity and identifiers: Interactions, device or advertising identifiers, and related diagnostics used for analytics and ads, subject to platform settings and consent.
• Diagnostics: Crash logs and performance information.
• Purchases: Subscription product and entitlement status handled through Apple or Google and RevenueCat. SafeBite does not receive your full payment card details.
Privacy.cameraBody: SafeBite requests permission to use the camera solely for scanning labels. We do not save photos to your gallery without permission.
Privacy.thirdPartyBody: Google ML Kit performs label text recognition on your device; label images are not sent to our servers for OCR. Supabase processes account details and signed-in scan-history sync. Firebase processes app analytics and crash/performance diagnostics. Google Mobile Ads serves rewarded ads and may process device or advertising identifiers and app interactions for ad delivery and measurement, based on platform settings and consent. RevenueCat helps manage subscription purchases and entitlement status with Apple and Google. We do not receive full payment card details.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can clear guest history on your device, restore purchases, or delete a signed-in account and its associated data from Settings in the app. If you cannot access the app, you can request deletion through the web page below.
Privacy.disclaimerBody: SafeBite is an informational tool. It is not a medical device. Always physically verify labels.

AccountDeletion.title: Request account deletion
AccountDeletion.intro: You can request deletion of your SafeBite account and the personal data associated with it.
AccountDeletion.inAppBody: If you can sign in, open Settings and choose Delete Account. Follow the confirmation steps in the app.
AccountDeletion.webTitle: If you cannot access the app
AccountDeletion.webBody: Email us from the email address linked to your SafeBite account so we can identify the account. Include only the account email address. Do not send your password, payment details, or label photos.
AccountDeletion.dataBody: We will use your request to locate the account and process deletion of the account and associated data that SafeBite controls. Some records may need to be retained where required by law or for legitimate transaction and security records; if that applies, we will explain it in our response.
AccountDeletion.safetyNote: Guest mode does not use an email account. Clear guest history in the app before uninstalling if you also want to remove data stored only on your device.
